text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur was amazing. Isn't she 
basically on the same level as those 
two...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I was underestimating them a bit? I 
think I'm gonna root for them from now 
on...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Accept it. That praise was meant for you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: For... me...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to offer my praises as well. That 
was truly magnificent fighting spirit, 
Shakur-san!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It feels as if a fresh breeze just blew 
through... You look like a whole new 
person! 'O sole mioâª

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "Shakur-san... I'm... so happy."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing everyone realize how amazing 
Shakur-san is... is what makes me the 
happiest~...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Air Shakur returned, he seemed lost 
in thought.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I want... more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As we took a somewhat roundabout walk 
together... she quietly began to open up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...In the end, I thought I was just weak.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, connecting with someone is 
what's desired most, and seeking approval 
is merely for that purpose..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Deep down, you're wishing, "I want them to 
understand." Thinking that's surely your 
greatest desire.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I thought that no matter how much you 
scream and shout, it's nothing more than a 
cry of pain..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Still, today made me realize it. That 
wasn't what I wanted at all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It ain't about 'likes.' It ain't about 
props, either. It's to-tal-ly freakin' 
different!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Being pushed away makes me sick, and 
understanding each other makes me wanna 
puke just as much.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Just for this very moment is enough. Burn 
it in so fiercely it'll leave a trauma—"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—I just wanted to exist so intensely that 
everyone would have no choice but to look 
at me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Uuuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...You. You told me to be proud of myself, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Damn right. The only one who can take 
pride in your ass is yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Still, I won't be satisfied if that's just 
a bluff.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Shut the noisy ones up. Then take pride 
in it. Ain't that right?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I'll win on the grandest stage. And 
truly, undeniably establish my own era.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
In a situation greater than ever 
before—one that leaves no room for 
doubt... I'll engrave myself into the 
thickest skull out there.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Ain't there a race where all the crazy 
bastards gather? Make a call."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A race where many of the top-tier 
Umamusume she's looking to face gather... 
Considering recent data and trends...
choice_data_list:
This year's Tenno Sho (Autumn) is shaping 
up to be an interesting one.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Explain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides T.M. Opera O and Meisho Doto, the 
one in this generation with standout 
ability aside from Air Shakur is—
choice_data_list: I Think Agnes Digital Will Show Up Too

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Her, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Agnes Digital. An Umamusume who debuted 
in the same generation as Air Shakur and 
has recently drawn a lot of attention.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Running on dirt, running miles, and now 
here? You really just do whatever you 
want, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You can tell just by looking.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Well, it just means they've resolved 
themselves in their own way.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, 'Parcae' also anticipated that 
Digital would enter the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The weather right now is heavy rain with a 
yielding track, absolute worst. Which is 
what makes it fun, huh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Got it. Then I'll crush both the older 
generation and our own...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Interesting. Shall we go, then—to the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)?"
